title: Hermosa Manor | KEY.co
description_expanded: Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive. Located in the exclusive Secluded Dunes community along scenic 30A, this luxurious eight-bedroom retreat offers the perfect blend of coastal elegance and family-friendly comfort—just a two-minute walk from the sugar-white sands of Seagrove Beach. With space for up to 28 guests across three thoughtfully designed levels, the home features a private heated pool, direct boardwalk beach access, and panoramic Gulf views from multiple balconies. A spacious kitchen, elegant dining spaces, and numerous gathering areas make it ideal for multi-family vacations or large group celebrations.
